Reconstructed the Urdu-script body in `mein-antqam-lon-ga.md` and moved the Roman transcription into `romanLyrics`. Set the direction to `rtl`, added the Roman alternate title, and removed the `noUrdu` tag. Verified that all nine stanzas and 91 verse lines align.

The Roman readings “ghazar,” “Yassal,” and “Gullale” remain ambiguous. I rendered them phonetically as غضر، یسال، and گلالِ.
